reason: After reviewing the complete 10-K filing for Trump Media & Technology Group Corp. (DJT) for fiscal year 2025, no Total Addressable Market (TAM) figure was disclosed by the company itself. The filing describes the company's business operations across Truth Social (social media), Truth+ (streaming), and Truth.Fi (financial services/FinTech), and mentions that these industries are 'highly competitive,' but does not provide any company-disclosed TAM estimates, market size figures, or addressable market quantifications from any official company sources such as investor presentations, earnings calls, or SEC filings.
